chapter.verse: Ni nih khit ciangin, Paisan pawi leh silngo om lo khomun pawikhamna tung ding hi. Tua lai takin siampi liante leh laitheite in zuauthu tawh Zeisu man-a a thah theih nading lampi a zong uh hi.
Ahih hangin mihonpi a gamlum khak ding a lunghihmawh manun, “Pawikham laitak hih kei ni,” a ci uh hi.
Bethani khua-ah miphak Simon’ inn sungah Zeisu om a, an a nek lai takin numei khat in a manpha mahmah, nard paknamtui suangngo thawl khat a suk khap khit ciangin, Topa’ lu tangah a nilhsak hi.
Mi kimkhatte heh uh a, “Paknamtui bang dingin a mawkna-in kizangsak hiam?
Tua paknamtui dangka za thumin kizuakin mizawngte a kipia thei hi,” a cih khit uh ciangin, tua numei a mawhsak uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Tua numei om sak ta un. Bang hang bawlsia na hi uh hiam? Amah in kei tungah thupha hong bawl zo hi.
Mizawngte in note tawh a omkhawm tawntung ding hi. Cikmah peuhin amaute tungah thupha hehpihna na bawl nop uh leh, na bawl thei uh hi. Kei ka hih leh, note tawh omkhawm tawntung ding ka hi kei hi.
Hih numei in ahih zawh zahin a hih zo hi. Keima luang vui nadingin ka pumpi paknamtui tawh a hong nilhkhol zo hi.
Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah Lungdamna Thu hilhna leitung khempeuh ah hih numei a kingaihsut nadingin ama hong bawlna thu a kigen ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Sawm-le-nihte lakah Judas Iskariot in, amaute khut tungah Zeisu pia dingin siampi liante kiangah va pai hi.
Amaute’n a zak uh ciangin nuam uh a, “Dangka-in kong guai ding uh hi,” ci-in a kiciam uh hi. Amah in Topa amaute’ khut sungah piak theih nading a zong hi.
Paisan tuuno a kigawh ni, silngo om lo khomun nek kipat ni-in a nungzuite in, “Paisan pawi na nek theih nadingin koi laitak mun hong bawlsak le-ung na deih hiam?” ci-in Zeisu kiangah a dong uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Khua sungah pai un la, tuibeel khat a pua mi khat tawh na kituak ding uh hi.
Tua mi nung zui un la, koimah peuh ci loin a lutna inn neipa kiangah, ‘Sia in, Keimah in ka nungzuite tawh Paisan Pawi ka nek nadingin na zin tun’na inndei koi lai-ah a om hiam? a ci hi,’ na ci un.
Tua mi in a kibawlsa dei tungnung a lian khat hong lak ding hi. Tua dei sungah ei ading na bawl khol un,” ci-in a nungzui nihte a sawl hi.
Tua nungzuite pai uh a, khua sung a tum uh ciangin Zeisu in a genkholh mah bangin a mu uh a, Paisan pawi a bawl khol uh hi.
Nitak ciangin Zeisu in Sawm-le-nihte tawh hong paikhawm uh hi.
Tu-a an a nek lai takun Zeisu in, “Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, note lakah kei tawh an a ne khawm khat in kei hong lehheek ding hi,” a ci hi.
A nungzuite a dah uh a, “Kei ka hi hiam?” ci-in khat nungah khat in a dong uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Sawm-le-nihte lakah khat, kei tawh ankuang ka sawk khawmpihpa ahi hi.

Mihing Tapa in Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin a pai ding hi. Ahih hangin Mihing Tapa a lehheekpa in gimna a thuak ding hi. Tua mipa in a nu sung pan suak kei leh, ama adingin a hoihzaw ding hi,” a ci hi.
Amau in an a nek laitakun Zeisu in khomun la a, hehpihna a phat khit ciangin khomun balnenin, “Hih khomun in ka pumpi ahi hi. La un,” ci-in a nungzuite a pia hi.
Hai zong la a, hehpihna a phat khit ciangin amau pia a, tuate khempeuh in a dawn uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Hih in mi tampi ading a kibuasa, kiciamna si ahi hi.
Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, leenggahtui Pasian Gam sungah ka nek thak ni matengin tu-a kipan ka dawn nawn kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Amaute in la a sak khit uh ciangin, Oliv Mual ah a paikhia uh hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in, “Tuucingpa ka satlum a, tuute a kithehthang ding hi,” ci-a Lai Siangtho sunga a kigelh bangin, note na vekpi un na lungkia ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin ka thawhkik khit ciangin, note mai-ah Galile gamah ka pai ding hi,” a cih ciangin,
Piter in, “Mi khempeuh a lungkia uh hangin keimah in ka lungkia kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, tuzan aak nihvei a khuan’ ma-in thumvei na hong nial ding hi,” a ci hi.
Piter in, “Nang tawh ka sikhawm zongin nangmah kong nial kei ding hi,” ci-in lungkhauhna tawh a gen hi. Amaute khempeuh in zong tua mah bangin a ci uh hi.
Tua lai takin Gethsemane kici mun khatah amaute a tun’ uh ciangin Zeisu in, “Keimah in thu ka nget lai takin hih lai-ah na tu un,” a nungzuite kiangah a cih khit ciangin,
Piter, Jokob leh Johan-te sam a, a lungman’na leh dahna a kipan hi.
Amah in, “Si dek takin ka dah hi; hih san takah ngakin na om un,” ci-in thu a pia hi.
Zeisu mai lamah tomkha pai-in lei-ah boksuk a, tua hun in amah tawh a kipelh zawh leh, a kipelh nadingin thu a ngen hi.
“Abba, Pa aw, na khempeuh na bawl thei hi. Hih hai kei tawh kipelhsak in; ahih hangin keima deihna bang hi kei hen, nangma deihna bang hi ta hen,” a ci hi.
A nungzuite kiangah a paikik leh, amaute ihmu a, om uh a muh ciangin Piter kiangah “Simon aw, ihmu na hi hiam? Nai khat nangawn kei tawh ngakkhawm zo lo na hi hiam?
Kheemna tawh na kipelh theih nadingin thu ngen in la, ngak in. Lungsim a ut hangin pumpi a thazawng hi,” a ci hi.
Khatvei va pai kikin a masa a nget bangin a ngen hi.
A hong pai kik leh, a nungzuite ihmu a, om uh a mu hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, a mit uh a kham hi. Ama kiangah a dawn kik nading a thei kei uh hi.
Thumveina hong paikik a, “Tu-in nuam takin ihmu un. A kicing zo hi. A hun hong tung zo hi. Mihing Tapa migilote’ khut sungah kilehheek zo hi.
Tho un, pai ni. Kei hong lehheekpa hong nai zo hi,” a ci hi.

Zeisu in a gen lai takin a nungzui sawm-le-nihte lak a khat, Judas in thakhatin hong pai a, siampi liante, laitheite leh upate in a sawl uh mihonpite in, namsau leh molhtumte tawi-in amah tawh hong tonkhawm uh hi.
Zeisu a lehheekpa in, “Ka nappa in Zeisu ahi hi; tua pa na man un la, paipih un,” ci-in amaute kiangah a lim a hilhkhol hi.
Amah a tun’ ciangin Topa kiangah thakhatin va nai a, “Topa aw,” ci-in a nam hi.
Amaute in Zeisu a mat khit uh ciangin a kai uh hi.
Tua lai takin a kianga dingte khat in, a namsau dokin siampi lian ukpa’ nasem khat a sat leh, a bil a satkhia hi.
Tua ciangin Zeisu in, ‘Note in galgu mat bangin kei man dingin namsau leh molhtum tawi-in na hong pai uh hiam?
Keimah in ni simin biakna innpi sungah thu hilh a, note tawh ka omkhawm lai takin nong man kei uh hi. Hih thute in Lai Siangtho hong tun’ nading ahi hi,” ci-in mihonpite kiangah a gen hi.
Tua ciangin, a nungzuite khempeuh in Topa a taisan uh hi.
Tangval khat in saihadial puan khat bek silhin Zeisu nung zui a,
amaute in a mat uh ciangin, a saihadial puan nusia-in puan nei loin a tai hi.
Amaute in siampi ukpa kiangah Zeisu a paipih uh hi. Siampi liante, upate leh laitheite khempeuh amah tawh a kikhawm uh hi.
Piter in siampi ukpa’ inntual dongin gamla sim a kihalin Zeisu zui a, palikte tawh mei a awi khawm hi.
Siampi liante leh upate khempeuh in Zeisu that dingin teci a zon’ uh hangin a mu kei uh hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, mi tampi in Zeisu lang khatah zuau teci a pan’ uh hangin a kithutuak kei uh hi.

Mi kimkhat ding uh a, “Hihpa in, ‘Keimah in khut tawh kibawl hih biakna innpi ka suksiat khit ciangin, khut tawh kibawl lo biakna innpi ni thum sungin ka lamkik ding hi,’ a cihna ka za uh hi,” ci-in zuau teci a pang uh hi.
Ahih hangin amau teci pan’na a kituak kei hi.

Siampi ukpa in amaute lai zangah ding a, “Nang kam khat beek dawng kik lo ding na hi hiam? Hih mite in nangma lang khatah teci bangci a pang uh hiam?” ci-in Zeisu kiangah a dot leh, Zeisu pau loin a om hi.
Khatvei siampi ukpa in, “Nang Thupha a nei, Pasian’ Tapa Khazih na hi hiam?” a cih kik ciangin,
Zeisu in, “Ka hi hi. Mihing Tapa in vangliatna ziatlam ah tu a, meii tungah hong kumsuk note in na mu ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin siampi ukpa in a puan balkeek a, “Adang bang teci deih lai i hi hiam?”
Pasian tungah a pau khialhna thu na za zo uh hi. Bangci ngaihsut na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi. Amaute khempeuh in, “Hih pa thah tuak hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua lai takin kimkhatte in Zeisu cil tawh phih uh a, a maitang tuamin a khut uh tawh a tum uh hi. “Pasian’ kamsangte bangin hong hilh in,” a ci uh hi. Palikte in khut tawh pang betin a paipih uh hi.
Piter in a nuai-ah inntual ah a om lai takin siampi ukpa’ nasem numei khat a kiangah pai a,
Piter mei awi-a om a muh ciangin lim takpi-in en a, “Nazareth mi Zeisu tawh na kipawl hi,” a ci hi.
Piter in, “Nang na cih pen ka thei kei, zong ka tel kei hi,” ci-in a nial hi. Inn limah a paikhiat khit ciangin aak a khuang hi.
Numei in Piter a muh kik ciangin tua munah a ding mite kiangah, “Hih pa zong tua mite khat ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Piter in a nial kik hi. Tua nung a sawt nai loin Piter kiangah a dingte in, “Hua mite khat na hi takpi hi, bang hang hiam na cih leh, Galile mi na hi hi,” a cih uh ciangin,
Piter in, “No na gen uh mi pen ke’n ka thei kei hi,” ci-in hamsia tawh a kiciam hi.
Tua phetin nihveina aak a khuang hi. Piter in, “Aak nihvei a khuan’ ma-in thumvei nong nial ding hi,” Zeisu in a cihna thu phawk a, a ngaihsut ciangin a kap hi.
